labels.text: Iran and Saudi Arabia agree to resume diplomatic relations which were severed in 2016, at talks mediated by China.
Canada and Saudi Arabia agree to restore full diplomatic relations after a breakdown in relations in 2018 over the assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.
Saudi Arabia is accused of mass killing hundreds of African migrants attempting to cross its border with Yemen.
2024 Hajj disaster: More than 1,300 people are reported to have died due to extreme heat during the annual Hajj pilgrimage in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.

FIFA announces that Morocco, Portugal and Spain will jointly host the 2030 World Cup, with anniversary matches to be held in Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay, while Saudi Arabia is confirmed as the host for 2034.
Vladimir Putin announces that Russia and the United States have officially agreed to restore diplomatic relations. A four-hour summit between the US and Russia is held in Saudi Arabia.
Turkey and Saudi Arabia sign an agreement to revive the 19th century Hejaz railway.
2026 Iran war: The Houthis announce a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia on the Bab el-Mandeb strait.

2026 Iran war: Saudi Arabia announces the establishment of a 14-nation military alliance to restore and protect freedom of navigation through the Red Sea amid the Iran conflict and ongoing crisis in the area stimulated by the Houthis.
Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey sign the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a mutual defence pact, amid the 2026 Iran war.
2026 Iran war: Saudi Arabia temporarily shuts down the East-West Pipeline following damage sustained from drone strikes launched from Iraqi territory.
Houthi-Saudi conflict: Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia agree to activate the Mecca defense pact in response to Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
Houthi-Saudi conflict: At least 20 people are killed and more than 350 others are injured in a series of attacks on airports perpetrated by the Houthis in Riyadh, Abha and Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
